title: Curriculum front matter
description: Front matter of workshop/slides/*.md, workshop/speaker-scripts/*.md and labs/*.md. The set of top-level properties is closed (additionalProperties false) and must equal the Key column of workshop/spa/docs/content-authoring.md (AC25). No key is required: labs/setup.md carries no front matter and the cover slide carries only title and role.

anchor_labs.description: Lab ids a module anchors; each resolves to labs/<id>.md.

lab_number.description: A positive integer for numbered labs; the extension and hardening labs use a string.

minutes.description: Time budget of the module in minutes.

module.description: Module code such as M1 or M5b.

pace.description: How long the lab takes when presenter-led and when self-paced.

phase.description: Curriculum build phase that produced the file, as a string such as 3a.

registry.description: Workspace-relative path of the lab registry.

role.description: Marks a slide file that is not a teaching module.

slide_source.description: Workspace-relative POSIX path of the slide file a speaker script accompanies.
